metadata.title: On the Willmore energy of flat $n$-tori in $\mathbb{R}^N$ and Chen's conjecture for $n$-tori
metadata.abstract: This paper establishes the sharp lower bound $(4n\pi^2)^{n/2}$ for the Willmore energy $\mathcal{W}$ of flat $n$-tori in the Euclidean space. Up to Möbius transformations, the Clifford $n$-torus $\mathbb{S}^1\bigl(\sqrt{1/n}\,\bigr) \times \cdots \times \mathbb{S}^1\bigl(\sqrt{1/n}\,\bigr) \subset \mathbb{S}^{2n-1} \subset \mathbb{R}^{2n}$ is shown to be the unique minimizer attaining this bound. This also confirms Chen's conjecture for flat $n$-tori. However, when $n \geq3 $, we show that Chen's conjecture fails on the total mean curvature of general immersed $n$-tori: certain Möbius transformations of the Clifford $n$-torus strictly decrease the total mean curvature.
